verdict.rationale: Salv documents a public API with a downloadable OpenAPI definition (public.yaml), OAuth2 client-credentials tokens, and a demo sandbox environment. The API covers the core operational loop programmatically: adding persons and transactions, running real-time monitoring checks, updating alert status, creating manual alerts, fetching risk factors, and receiving webhook events. Missing for 10: configuration is only partly exposed through the API (Custom Lists is the documented example), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
